visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt featuring an avocado print, stands in a bedroom setting. She holds a bright pink curved vent brush in her right hand and a tan wooden paddle brush in her left. The background features a wooden bed frame with designer shopping bags from Louis Vuitton and Gucci perched on it. (2) The woman lifts the wooden paddle brush to the right side of her head and begins brushing her hair downward. Her facial expression tightens, and she winks as if experiencing slight discomfort or a snag in her hair. (3) She switches to the pink vent brush on the left side of her hair. The brush moves smoothly through the strands without resistance. Her eyes widen and her expression becomes one of pleasant surprise. (4) She holds the pink brush closer to the camera lens, showing the open-slat design and the tips of the bristles. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen throughout the sequence. (5) In the final phase, she continues talking directly into the camera while holding the pink brush, concluding the demonstration with a thumbs-up gesture and a smile.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a product review and recommendation for a specific type of 'air hairbrush' (vent brush). By physically comparing it to a traditional wooden paddle brush, the creator demonstrates the product's superiority in detangling hair without pain and reducing hair drying time. The intent is to inform viewers about the product's effectiveness and its affordability across common retail stores.
